static_traits.name: Liu Dawei
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk to, but has not yet shared self-critical thoughts out of shame; self-isolation at Work has left Relationship with colleagues affected
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; not yet received counseling before; no similar self-critical experiences in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe trigger situations and automatic thoughts concretely; negative mood, feeling hopeless; skeptical about change but willing to try; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I am struggling with self-criticism and feelings of inferiority, especially regarding my ability to take care of my belongings.
basic_info.core_demands: The decisive factor prompting me to seek counseling this time is realizing that self-critical thoughts are affecting my self-esteem and overall physical and mental health, and affecting my work performance.
growth_experiences: Due to financial reasons, not yet able to enter nursing school, gradually forming the belief that 'nothing I want can ever be achieved, because of money'; whenever planning for the future it feels like hitting a wall, with recurring hopelessness and a sense of being constrained, affecting Family relationships and mood.

In recent months Work deadlines have been intense with long overtime hours, Increased stress; over time, repeatedly feeling ashamed of the car's mess and odor and labeling myself a 'slob', with multiple cleaning attempts failing to ease negative thinking, accompanied by interpersonal Withdrawal and Decreased attention.

core_beliefs: I am a slob/incompetent, unable to take good care of my belongings.
Because of money constraints, I can never achieve the goals I want.

special_situations.event: Each time entering a car or thinking about the car's cleanliness and smell
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the car is not clean or smells, it proves I am a slob who cannot take care of myself and my things
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Cleans the car many times, trying to make a maintenance checklist and fixed cleaning times
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My car is filthy and stinks because I am a slob who cannot manage my own things

special_situations.event: Phases of facing work deadlines and long overtime
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot keep both Work and life perfect at the same time, it means I am not good enough/incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Working doubly to compensate, reducing interaction with colleagues to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot do anything right/I cannot keep up

special_situations.event: When planning for the future or setting personal goals
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not have enough money now, I can never achieve my goals
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing finances and the future with family and friends, Repressing hope to avoid disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never afford what I want; I will not succeed, because of money

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as capable, able to care for myself and take charge of life and the future
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being seen as a failure/slob and suffering shame; fear of Being rejected and disappointed due to financial limits
defense_goal: Through harsh self-criticism, preempts to avoid the shame brought by external blame
Keeps distance and self-isolates to reduce being evaluated
Attributing difficulties to external limits (e.g., money, busy Work) to ease guilt and Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: A helpless person constrained by external limits
object_relations.object_representation: The world/environment is one of scarcity, limits, and unchangeability

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests identifying negative thoughts and trying small changes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feeling change is impossible, that no amount of effort will help (taking the counselor's hope as unrealistic)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Negative tone, low energy, using absolutist words (like 'no need' 'won't change'), responding to suggestions with 'I cannot do it/impossible.'

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether they communicate financial worries and emotions with family or friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes speaking out will only increase the other person's burden or be misunderstood; pressing emotions down is safer
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplays the related emotions and shifts to objective details or other topics, reducing emotional vocabulary and self-disclosure.

manifestations: Not yet able to attend nursing school for financial reasons
Feeling like hitting a wall when planning for the future, Restricted choices
Attributing success or failure entirely to money
outcomes: Worsening sense of powerlessness and hopelessness

manifestations: Not sharing self-criticism and Financial worries with friends
outcomes: Negative thought cycle maintained, Low mood

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Mainly attributing 'never able to succeed' to external money factors (e.g., 'I just will not succeed, because of money')
Externalizing limits when facing the future, weakening one's own agency and choice

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to do a certain behavior toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others outwardly to do something for them, and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'
manifestations: Self-isolating at work, Repressing the need for communication and support
Not expressing worries to friends or family out of shame

exception_events.target_problem: When planning for the future or thinking about goals, the client repeatedly has thoughts like 'I can never afford it / will not succeed', feeling hopeless and avoiding communication with family.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At moments doing simple things at home or focusing on a movie, he did not ruminate or feel hopeless as usual; instead his attention was drawn to the current activity and emotional pressure eased temporarily.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different situations/different approaches -- simpler tasks, attention occupied by concrete activities, bringing brief relaxation and Distraction, thus not triggering the old thought chain.

positive_force: Proactively seeks counseling; willing to try small-step changes
Able to notice and describe trigger situations and negative Automatic thoughts
Has work and a basic life structure, has a degree of self-management willingness (tries cleaning the vehicle, making a budget)
Has some friends and a generally supportive family
Able to briefly detach from problems when focusing on specific activities (showing potential for attention regulation)
negative_force: Marked cognitive biases: self-labeling, overgeneralization, 'predicting the future', etc.
Strong shame, avoiding communication and help-seeking, self-isolating at work
Work deadlines and overtime pressure are great, encroaching on self-care time
Externalizing the sense of control to money, forming helplessness and giving-up tendencies
Frequent negative rumination interferes with work and daily organization

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated self-deprecation and labeling inner speech
antecedent: Getting into the car or smelling an odd odor inside
Thinking about how clean the car is
Busy work and overtime causing exhaustion
target_behavior.core_reason: Equates the tidiness of items directly with self-worth, forming overgeneralization and labeling cognitions
target_behavior.function: Avoids the threat of being evaluated by others; gains an illusion of control through self-criticism
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem with worsening shame, scattered attention, impaired Work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Self-isolates at work, reduces communication with colleagues
antecedent: In the workplace after negative self-evaluation is activated
Worrying about being seen as 'I am not good enough'
target_behavior.core_reason: Fears being judged and shamed, thus avoids interaction
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncomfortable emotions and potential negative judgment
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged relationships with colleagues,Reduced social support,Increased sense of isolation

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophizing and 'never will' style rumination when planning for the future/finances
antecedent: When planning future goals or budgets
Recalling the experience of not yet being able to afford nursing school
target_behavior.core_reason: Generalizing one financially constrained experience into a stable rule, producing the predictive belief of 'never able to succeed'
target_behavior.function: Retreating early to avoid failure and disappointment
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased motivation and avoiding action, maintaining helplessness and low mood
